description: Update a line item on an order (quantity, unit price, discount, name, or SKU). Recomputes the order total. Use get_order to find the order's externalId and the item's itemId. The result echoes the operating workspace.

externalId.description: The order externalId returned by list_orders or create_order.

itemId.description: The order item id returned by get_order.

patch.description: The order item fields to update; include at least one changed field.

discount.description: Percentage discount on this line (0-100). Default 0.

productName.description: Line item name, snapshotted onto the order. Use search_products to quote a real catalog product's name. Required.

unitPrice.description: Price per unit in the order currency, as a decimal (e.g. 199.99). Snapshotted onto the line.

name: update_order_item
title: Update order item
